---
title: "Module 05: Single-cell RNA-seq cell-cell communication analysis with CellChat"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-06"
---

```{r}

#==============================================================================
# MODULE 05 — Single-cell CellChat communication analysis
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Perform ligand-receptor cell-cell communication analysis using CellChat
#   on the SingleR-annotated GSE298688 single-cell RNA-seq dataset generated
#   in Module 04. Filter poorly annotated and very small cell populations,
#   optionally downsample large populations, infer ligand-receptor
#   communication probabilities, aggregate signaling pathways, calculate
#   signaling-network centrality, generate CellChat visualizations, export
#   communication tables, and save reproducible checkpoint objects.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/single_cell/
#     GSE298688_SingleR_annotated_seurat.rds
#
# Primary output objects:
#   data/processed/single_cell/cellchat/
#     GSE298688_CellChat_SingleR_broad.rds
#     GSE298688_CellChat_input_Seurat.rds
#
# Output tables:
#   results/single_cell/cellchat/
#
# Output figures:
#   figures/single_cell/cellchat/
#
# CellChat grouping variable:
#   SingleR_broad_pruned
#
# Cell filtering:
#   - Unassigned or invalid SingleR labels are excluded.
#   - Cell populations containing fewer than 10 cells are excluded.
#   - Groups larger than 1,000 cells are downsampled.
#
# CellChat settings:
#   Database:             CellChatDB.mouse
#   Mean expression:      truncatedMean
#   Trim:                 0.1
#   Population weighting: FALSE
#   Spatial distance:     FALSE
#   Minimum cells/group:  10
#
# Notes:
#   - This is a single-cell RNA-seq CellChat analysis.
#   - Spatial distance is therefore not incorporated.
#   - Broad SingleR identities are used to avoid excessively small groups.
#   - CellChat predicts potential signaling interactions and does not
#     demonstrate direct physical or causal interactions.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required packages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(CellChat)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(future)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(here)
})


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reproducibility settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1234)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

annotation_column <- "SingleR_broad_pruned"

minimum_cells_per_group <- 10

maximum_cells_per_group <- 1000

cellchat_workers <- 4

communication_mean_type <- "truncatedMean"

communication_trim <- 0.1

pathways_requested <- c(
  "MIF",
  "CCL",
  "SPP1",
  "TGFb"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell"
)

cellchat_object_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell",
  "cellchat"
)

cellchat_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "single_cell",
  "cellchat"
)

cellchat_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "cellchat"
)

directories_to_create <- c(
  processed_directory,
  cellchat_object_directory,
  cellchat_results_directory,
  cellchat_figure_directory
)

for (directory in directories_to_create) {
  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}

input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_annotated_seurat.rds"
)

cellchat_output_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_object_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_SingleR_broad.rds"
)

cellchat_input_seurat_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_object_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_input_Seurat.rds"
)

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 05 — Single-cell CellChat communication analysis\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Repository root:    ", here::here(), "\n",
  "Input object:       ", input_file, "\n",
  "CellChat objects:   ", cellchat_object_directory, "\n",
  "Results directory: ", cellchat_results_directory, "\n",
  "Figure directory:  ", cellchat_figure_directory, "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Validate and load Module 04 output
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(
    "Module 04 output was not found:\n",
    input_file,
    "\n\nRun Module 04 before Module 05."
  )
}

cat("Loading SingleR-annotated Seurat object...\n")

single_cell <- readRDS(input_file)

if (!inherits(single_cell, "Seurat")) {
  stop("Loaded input file is not a valid Seurat object.")
}

if (!"RNA" %in% Seurat::Assays(single_cell)) {
  stop("RNA assay was not found in the input Seurat object.")
}

if (!annotation_column %in% colnames(single_cell@meta.data)) {
  stop(
    "Requested CellChat annotation column was not found:\n",
    annotation_column
  )
}

Seurat::DefaultAssay(single_cell) <- "RNA"

cat(
  "Object loaded successfully:\n",
  "  Genes:   ", nrow(single_cell), "\n",
  "  Cells:   ", ncol(single_cell), "\n",
  "  Samples: ", length(unique(single_cell$sample)), "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Inspect and validate normalized RNA expression
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Inspecting normalized RNA expression\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

rna_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  single_cell[["RNA"]]
)

cat("RNA assay layers:\n")

print(rna_layers)

if (sum(grepl("^data", rna_layers)) > 1) {
  cat(
    "\nMultiple normalized RNA data layers detected.\n",
    "Joining RNA layers before CellChat analysis...\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  single_cell <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    single_cell,
    assay = "RNA"
  )
}

if (!"data" %in% SeuratObject::Layers(single_cell[["RNA"]])) {
  stop(
    "Normalized RNA data layer was not found. ",
    "Run Module 03 before performing CellChat analysis."
  )
}

rna_data <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
  single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)

if (nrow(rna_data) == 0 || ncol(rna_data) == 0) {
  stop("Normalized RNA expression matrix is empty.")
}

cat(
  "Normalized RNA expression confirmed:\n",
  "  Genes: ", nrow(rna_data), "\n",
  "  Cells: ", ncol(rna_data), "\n",
  sep = ""
)

rm(rna_data)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Create CellChat grouping metadata
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Preparing CellChat cell-type identities\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

single_cell$cellchat_cell_type <- as.character(
  single_cell@meta.data[[annotation_column]]
)

invalid_labels <- c(
  "",
  "NA",
  "Unknown",
  "Unassigned",
  "Not assigned"
)

valid_cells <- !is.na(single_cell$cellchat_cell_type) &
  !single_cell$cellchat_cell_type %in% invalid_labels

cells_removed_invalid <- sum(!valid_cells)

single_cell_cellchat <- subset(
  single_cell,
  cells = colnames(single_cell)[valid_cells]
)

if (ncol(single_cell_cellchat) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No cells remained after removing invalid CellChat annotations."
  )
}

single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type <- droplevels(
  factor(single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type)
)

Seurat::Idents(single_cell_cellchat) <- "cellchat_cell_type"

cat(
  "Cells removed because of invalid/unassigned labels: ",
  cells_removed_invalid,
  "\n",
  "Cells retained after annotation filtering: ",
  ncol(single_cell_cellchat),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Examine cell numbers by CellChat group
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cell_type_counts_before_filter <- sort(
  table(single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type),
  decreasing = TRUE
)

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Cell numbers by CellChat group before size filtering\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

print(cell_type_counts_before_filter)

cell_type_count_before_table <- data.frame(
  cell_type = names(cell_type_counts_before_filter),
  cells = as.integer(cell_type_counts_before_filter),
  row.names = NULL
)

cell_type_count_before_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_cell_type_counts_before_filtering.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  cell_type_count_before_table,
  cell_type_count_before_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Remove very small cell populations
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cell_types_to_keep <- names(
  cell_type_counts_before_filter[
    cell_type_counts_before_filter >= minimum_cells_per_group
  ]
)

cell_types_removed <- names(
  cell_type_counts_before_filter[
    cell_type_counts_before_filter < minimum_cells_per_group
  ]
)

if (length(cell_types_removed) > 0) {
  cat(
    "\nCell types removed because they contained fewer than ",
    minimum_cells_per_group,
    " cells:\n",
    paste(cell_types_removed, collapse = ", "),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}

cells_to_keep <- colnames(single_cell_cellchat)[
  single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type %in% cell_types_to_keep
]

single_cell_cellchat <- subset(
  single_cell_cellchat,
  cells = cells_to_keep
)

if (ncol(single_cell_cellchat) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No cells remained after minimum group-size filtering."
  )
}

single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type <- droplevels(
  factor(single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type)
)

Seurat::Idents(single_cell_cellchat) <- "cellchat_cell_type"


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Downsample large cell populations
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Optional group downsampling\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

cat(
  "Maximum cells retained per CellChat group: ",
  maximum_cells_per_group,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

if (is.finite(maximum_cells_per_group)) {
  single_cell_cellchat <- subset(
    single_cell_cellchat,
    downsample = maximum_cells_per_group
  )

  single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type <- droplevels(
    factor(single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type)
  )

  Seurat::Idents(single_cell_cellchat) <- "cellchat_cell_type"
}

cell_type_counts_final <- sort(
  table(single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type),
  decreasing = TRUE
)

cat("\nFinal CellChat group sizes:\n")

print(cell_type_counts_final)

cat(
  "\nFinal cells included in CellChat: ",
  ncol(single_cell_cellchat),
  "\n",
  "Final cell types included: ",
  length(cell_type_counts_final),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cell_type_count_final_table <- data.frame(
  cell_type = names(cell_type_counts_final),
  cells = as.integer(cell_type_counts_final),
  row.names = NULL
)

cell_type_count_final_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_cell_type_counts_final.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  cell_type_count_final_table,
  cell_type_count_final_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Reconfirm normalized expression after subsetting
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

rna_data_final <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
  single_cell_cellchat,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)

if (nrow(rna_data_final) == 0 || ncol(rna_data_final) == 0) {
  stop(
    "Normalized RNA expression was not retained after CellChat subsetting."
  )
}

cat(
  "\nCellChat input expression matrix:\n",
  "  Genes: ", nrow(rna_data_final), "\n",
  "  Cells: ", ncol(rna_data_final), "\n",
  sep = ""
)

rm(rna_data_final)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Create CellChat object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Creating CellChat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

cellchat <- CellChat::createCellChat(
  object = single_cell_cellchat,
  group.by = "cellchat_cell_type",
  assay = "RNA"
)

if (!inherits(cellchat, "CellChat")) {
  stop("CellChat object was not created successfully.")
}

cat(
  "CellChat object created successfully using: ",
  annotation_column,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Assign mouse CellChat ligand-receptor database
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cellchat@DB <- CellChat::CellChatDB.mouse

cat(
  "Mouse CellChat ligand-receptor database assigned.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Retain signaling genes represented in the dataset
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Subsetting CellChat signaling genes\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

cellchat <- CellChat::subsetData(cellchat)

cat(
  "CellChat signaling gene subset prepared successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Configure parallel processing
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Configuring parallel processing\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Workers: ",
  cellchat_workers,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

future::plan(
  strategy = "multisession",
  workers = cellchat_workers
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Identify overexpressed signaling genes and interactions
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Identifying overexpressed signaling genes and interactions\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

cellchat <- CellChat::identifyOverExpressedGenes(
  cellchat
)

cellchat <- CellChat::identifyOverExpressedInteractions(
  cellchat
)

cat(
  "Overexpressed signaling genes and interactions identified.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Infer cell-cell communication probabilities
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Computing cell-cell communication probabilities\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

cellchat <- CellChat::computeCommunProb(
  object = cellchat,
  type = communication_mean_type,
  trim = communication_trim,
  raw.use = TRUE,
  population.size = FALSE,
  distance.use = FALSE
)

cellchat <- CellChat::filterCommunication(
  cellchat,
  min.cells = minimum_cells_per_group
)

cat(
  "Cell-cell communication probabilities calculated successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 18. Compute pathway-level communication networks
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Computing pathway-level communication networks\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

cellchat <- CellChat::computeCommunProbPathway(
  cellchat
)

cellchat <- CellChat::aggregateNet(
  cellchat
)

cat(
  "Pathway-level communication networks calculated successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 19. Compute signaling-network centrality
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Computing signaling-network centrality\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

cellchat <- CellChat::netAnalysis_computeCentrality(
  cellchat,
  slot.name = "netP"
)

future::plan(
  strategy = "sequential"
)

cat(
  "Incoming and outgoing signaling centrality calculated successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 20. Export ligand-receptor communication table
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

communication_table <- CellChat::subsetCommunication(
  cellchat
)

if (nrow(communication_table) == 0) {
  warning(
    "No ligand-receptor interactions were returned by subsetCommunication()."
  )
}

communication_table_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_ligand_receptor_interactions.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  communication_table,
  communication_table_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\nLigand-receptor interactions exported: ",
  nrow(communication_table),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 21. Export pathway-level communication table
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pathway_communication_table <- CellChat::subsetCommunication(
  cellchat,
  slot.name = "netP"
)

pathway_communication_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_pathway_interactions.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  pathway_communication_table,
  pathway_communication_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 22. Export detected signaling pathways
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

detected_pathways <- data.frame(
  pathway = cellchat@netP$pathways,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

detected_pathway_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_detected_pathways.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  detected_pathways,
  detected_pathway_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(
  "Detected signaling pathways: ",
  length(cellchat@netP$pathways),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 23. Save CellChat analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cellchat_parameters <- data.frame(
  parameter = c(
    "annotation_column",
    "minimum_cells_per_group",
    "maximum_cells_per_group",
    "cellchat_database",
    "database_scope",
    "communication_mean_type",
    "communication_trim",
    "raw_use",
    "population_size",
    "distance_use",
    "parallel_workers"
  ),
  value = c(
    annotation_column,
    minimum_cells_per_group,
    maximum_cells_per_group,
    "CellChatDB.mouse",
    "Complete mouse database",
    communication_mean_type,
    communication_trim,
    TRUE,
    FALSE,
    FALSE,
    cellchat_workers
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cellchat_parameter_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_parameters.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  cellchat_parameters,
  cellchat_parameter_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 24. Prepare group-size information for network visualization
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

group_size <- as.numeric(
  table(cellchat@idents)
)

interaction_matrix <- cellchat@net$weight

if (length(group_size) == 0 || nrow(interaction_matrix) == 0) {
  stop(
    "CellChat network information was not available for visualization."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 25. Plot global CellChat communication networks
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

global_network_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_global_networks.png"
)

grDevices::png(
  filename = global_network_file,
  width = 14,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 400
)

graphics::par(
  mfrow = c(1, 2),
  xpd = TRUE
)

CellChat::netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$count,
  vertex.weight = group_size,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "Number of interactions"
)

CellChat::netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$weight,
  vertex.weight = group_size,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "Interaction strength"
)

grDevices::dev.off()


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 26. Plot outgoing communication networks by cell type
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

number_of_groups <- nrow(
  interaction_matrix
)

number_of_columns <- 3

number_of_rows <- ceiling(
  number_of_groups / number_of_columns
)

outgoing_network_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_outgoing_networks_by_cell_type.png"
)

grDevices::png(
  filename = outgoing_network_file,
  width = 18,
  height = max(8, number_of_rows * 5),
  units = "in",
  res = 400
)

graphics::par(
  mfrow = c(number_of_rows, number_of_columns),
  xpd = TRUE
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(interaction_matrix))) {
  cell_type_matrix <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = nrow(interaction_matrix),
    ncol = ncol(interaction_matrix),
    dimnames = dimnames(interaction_matrix)
  )

  cell_type_matrix[i, ] <- interaction_matrix[i, ]

  CellChat::netVisual_circle(
    cell_type_matrix,
    vertex.weight = group_size,
    weight.scale = TRUE,
    edge.weight.max = max(
      interaction_matrix,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    label.edge = FALSE,
    title.name = rownames(interaction_matrix)[i]
  )
}

grDevices::dev.off()


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 27. Plot ligand-receptor bubble plot
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ligand_receptor_bubble_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_ligand_receptor_bubble.png"
)

grDevices::png(
  filename = ligand_receptor_bubble_file,
  width = 18,
  height = 12,
  units = "in",
  res = 400
)

CellChat::netVisual_bubble(
  cellchat,
  remove.isolate = TRUE,
  font.size = 9
)

grDevices::dev.off()


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 28. Plot outgoing signaling-role heatmap
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

outgoing_heatmap_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_outgoing_signaling_heatmap.png"
)

grDevices::png(
  filename = outgoing_heatmap_file,
  width = 9,
  height = 9,
  units = "in",
  res = 400
)

CellChat::netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
  cellchat,
  pattern = "outgoing"
)

grDevices::dev.off()


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 29. Plot incoming signaling-role heatmap
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

incoming_heatmap_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_incoming_signaling_heatmap.png"
)

grDevices::png(
  filename = incoming_heatmap_file,
  width = 9,
  height = 9,
  units = "in",
  res = 400
)

CellChat::netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
  cellchat,
  pattern = "incoming"
)

grDevices::dev.off()


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 30. Plot global signaling-role network
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

signaling_role_network_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_signaling_role_network.png"
)

grDevices::png(
  filename = signaling_role_network_file,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  res = 400
)

CellChat::netAnalysis_signalingRole_network(
  cellchat,
  signaling = cellchat@netP$pathways,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  font.size = 8
)

grDevices::dev.off()


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 31. Identify requested pathways available in this dataset
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pathways_of_interest <- intersect(
  pathways_requested,
  cellchat@netP$pathways
)

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Selected pathway visualization\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

if (length(pathways_of_interest) > 0) {
  cat(
    "Requested pathways detected:\n",
    paste(pathways_of_interest, collapse = ", "),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "None of the requested example pathways were detected.\n"
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 32. Plot selected pathway communication networks
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pathway_network_files <- character(0)

if (length(pathways_of_interest) > 0) {
  for (pathway in pathways_of_interest) {
    safe_pathway <- gsub(
      "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      "_",
      pathway
    )

    pathway_network_file <- file.path(
      cellchat_figure_directory,
      paste0(
        "GSE298688_CellChat_",
        safe_pathway,
        "_network.png"
      )
    )

    grDevices::png(
      filename = pathway_network_file,
      width = 9,
      height = 9,
      units = "in",
      res = 400
    )

    CellChat::netVisual_aggregate(
      cellchat,
      signaling = pathway,
      layout = "circle"
    )

    grDevices::dev.off()

    pathway_network_files <- c(
      pathway_network_files,
      pathway_network_file
    )
  }
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 33. Plot selected pathway ligand-receptor contributions
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pathway_contribution_files <- character(0)

if (length(pathways_of_interest) > 0) {

  for (pathway in pathways_of_interest) {

    safe_pathway <- gsub(
      "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      "_",
      pathway
    )

    pathway_contribution_file <- file.path(
      cellchat_figure_directory,
      paste0(
        "GSE298688_CellChat_",
        safe_pathway,
        "_ligand_receptor_contribution.png"
      )
    )

    cat(
      "Generating ligand-receptor contribution plot for ",
      pathway,
      "...\n",
      sep = ""
    )

    contribution_plot <- CellChat::netAnalysis_contribution(
      cellchat,
      signaling = pathway,
      title = pathway
    )

    grDevices::png(
      filename = pathway_contribution_file,
      width = 10,
      height = 8,
      units = "in",
      res = 400
    )

    print(
      contribution_plot
    )

    grDevices::dev.off()

    if (file.exists(pathway_contribution_file)) {

      pathway_contribution_files <- c(
        pathway_contribution_files,
        pathway_contribution_file
      )

      cat(
        "Saved: ",
        pathway_contribution_file,
        "\n",
        sep = ""
      )

    } else {

      warning(
        "Contribution plot was not created for pathway: ",
        pathway
      )
    }
  }
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 34. Validate completed CellChat object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Validating completed CellChat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

if (!inherits(cellchat, "CellChat")) {
  stop(
    "Final CellChat object is not valid."
  )
}

if (length(cellchat@netP$pathways) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No signaling pathways were detected by CellChat."
  )
}

if (length(cellchat@idents) != ncol(single_cell_cellchat)) {
  stop(
    "CellChat identity count does not match the number of input cells."
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(single_cell_cellchat)) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated cell barcodes were detected in the CellChat input Seurat object."
  )
}

cat(
  "Completed CellChat object validation passed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 35. Save CellChat object and exact Seurat input subset
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Saving CellChat analysis objects\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

saveRDS(
  object = cellchat,
  file = cellchat_output_file,
  compress = TRUE
)

saveRDS(
  object = single_cell_cellchat,
  file = cellchat_input_seurat_file,
  compress = TRUE
)

if (!file.exists(cellchat_output_file)) {
  stop(
    "CellChat object was not saved successfully:\n",
    cellchat_output_file
  )
}

if (!file.exists(cellchat_input_seurat_file)) {
  stop(
    "CellChat input Seurat subset was not saved successfully:\n",
    cellchat_input_seurat_file
  )
}

cat(
  "CellChat objects saved successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 36. Validate expected Module 05 outputs
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_object_files <- c(
  cellchat_output_file,
  cellchat_input_seurat_file
)

expected_result_files <- c(
  cell_type_count_before_file,
  cell_type_count_final_file,
  communication_table_file,
  pathway_communication_file,
  detected_pathway_file,
  cellchat_parameter_file,
  session_info_file
)

expected_figure_files <- c(
  global_network_file,
  outgoing_network_file,
  ligand_receptor_bubble_file,
  outgoing_heatmap_file,
  incoming_heatmap_file,
  signaling_role_network_file,
  pathway_network_files,
  pathway_contribution_files
)

missing_object_files <- expected_object_files[
  !file.exists(expected_object_files)
]

missing_result_files <- expected_result_files[
  !file.exists(expected_result_files)
]

missing_figure_files <- expected_figure_files[
  !file.exists(expected_figure_files)
]

if (length(missing_object_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 05 object files were not created:\n",
    paste(missing_object_files, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

if (length(missing_result_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 05 result files were not created:\n",
    paste(missing_result_files, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

if (length(missing_figure_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 05 figure files were not created:\n",
    paste(missing_figure_files, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

cat(
  "All expected Module 05 outputs were created successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 37. Final module summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 05 COMPLETE — Single-cell CellChat analysis\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Annotation used:              ", annotation_column, "\n",
  "Input cells:                  ", ncol(single_cell), "\n",
  "Cells analyzed:               ", ncol(single_cell_cellchat), "\n",
  "Cell types analyzed:          ",
  length(levels(single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type)),
  "\n",
  "Minimum cells/group:          ", minimum_cells_per_group, "\n",
  "Maximum cells/group:          ", maximum_cells_per_group, "\n",
  "Ligand-receptor interactions: ", nrow(communication_table), "\n",
  "Signaling pathways detected:  ",
  length(cellchat@netP$pathways),
  "\n",
  "Selected pathways plotted:    ",
  length(pathways_of_interest),
  "\n",
  "\n",
  "Primary CellChat object:\n",
  "  ", cellchat_output_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Exact Seurat input subset:\n",
  "  ", cellchat_input_seurat_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "CellChat result tables:\n",
  "  ", cellchat_results_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "CellChat figures:\n",
  "  ", cellchat_figure_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Next module:\n",
  "  Module 06 — Spatial transcriptomics\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
